notes: Single Puerto Rican row and no second division exists in our data, so the league is closed in both directions. In reality clubs enter and leave administratively (Guayama FC and FC Mayagüez left after 2025-26 and nobody joined), with no promotion or relegation route documented. Nine clubs, two championships (Apertura from 15 August 2026 and Clausura) in an identical format, each a round-robin plus a top-four play-off. The round count and the play-off legs are unknown; the article contradicts itself on eight v nine clubs. Several clubs share grounds and play in front of 1,000 or fewer, and the league is in only its third season under the LPR Pro name with its fifth Apertura/Clausura split.
